title: Lightmap for omni and spotlight is being Shared for multiple Cameras on mobile and compatiblity render
body: ### Tested versions - Reproducible in : 4.6stable[89cea1439] ### System information Linux mint 22.3 - 4.6stable[89cea1439] - compatiblity & Mobile - nvidia rtx 3060 mobile - driver 580.126.09 ### Issue description light maps for objects seem to be shared between the first camera and other camera looking at the same object while outside the light range with a similar angle in the view port - if both objects are in the light range (if the light is big) then the problem resolves its self - the second camera does not case the same problem for the first camera (idk which one would be considered the first but it seems to be caused in one direction i.e one camera rendering the light will bleed to the others but the others don't bleed on the first) - it is very angle dependent as shifting the pitch of the second camera or with case the light to fade away - the light bleed is objects related as both cameras need to rendering the same object at the same time ( noticeable mostly on floors as they are big enough to be included in both views while avoiding being in the light range) problem is very noticeable on split screen setups on compatibility and mobile renders the problem does show up on a duel view port for split screen https://youtu.be/D8KfHknzNus please check the MRP, as the problem easy to see hard to describe ### Steps to reproduce - switch godot to either compatibility or mobile render - create a floor in the scene using a plane or box - place a spot light or directional light in the scene for it to cast its light on the floor - place a camera looking at the light created (preferably close to the light source to view the full light area) - in the game viewport move the move away from the area covered by the light and slowly adjust the pitch while pointing at the floor (try to mimic the angle and possession of the first camera) - a light spot would appear where no omni light or spot light is with the same properties (color) as the other one ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) [MRP](https://github.com/Real-EdgeLord/godot_ligting_issue)
